title: fix: keep legacy text proxy requests on the origin host
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The legacy text cache Worker now forwards requests to its configured ORIGIN_HOST, including unusual leading-slash paths and their query strings. A regression test covers this routing. The image cache Worker is unaffected.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art server shed, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and guides a winding request path from a glowing text terminal to a single vine-covered origin server, with lime green (#ecf874) light and soft pastel gradients throughout. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, strictly pixel art, with cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
